text: Hi, I'm Paul, and this is Butler, an Alexa+ add-on that takes care of everyday things for you and turns your corrections into rules the AI can't break.
It's running on an Echo Show in my simulator and talking to the real backend on AWS, and the Black Box on the right logs every decision the gateway makes.
I don't give Butler commands, I just tell it what's going on.
Tell Butler six friends from the dinner crew are coming over Friday at seven.
Butler makes a plan and starts working on it right away.
It won't interrupt me, it just waits until I check in.
How's Friday looking?
It needs me to pick a cleaner, so I'll go with BrightHome.
My tap goes through a separate approval path, because the AI isn't allowed to approve things for itself.
Everything Butler does comes with a receipt.
Why did you buy the drinks?
It shows me what it knew, the options it turned down, and the rule that let it go ahead.
Don't buy drinks without asking me.
Yes.
The AI only picks a rule template, and plain code turns that into a policy the gateway enforces, so you can see the new rule right here.
I'm travelling Thursday to Sunday, and my parents are staying at the house.
Butler tried to buy drinks for my parents, and the gateway blocked it before a single cent was spent, completely outside the AI.
Anything you need from me?
So instead of buying them, it asks me first.
What did you do this week that I might disagree with?
That's Butler, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and thanks for watching!
Got it, six guests Friday at 7 PM. I'll handle invites, the calendar and drinks, and I'll check with you on cleaning.
I invited 6 guests, added dinner to your calendar and bought drinks for 42 dollars. One thing for you: which cleaner should I book?
I booked a cleaner for 85 dollars. You approved it.
I bought drinks for 42 dollars because you have 6 guests coming. Your 50 dollar limit allowed it.
From now on, I'll ask before buying drinks. Should I make that a rule?
Done, from now on I'll ask before buying drinks. Want me to refund that purchase too?
Got it, you're away Thursday to Sunday. I'll handle letting people know, your calendar and drinks.
I told your parents the plan and blocked your calendar. One thing for you: OK to buy drinks for 31 dollars?
Two things might bother you, starting with: booked a cleaner. It's the first time I booked a cleaner.
